theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The app is a privacy-first, crypto-native messenger. Using Archetype 7 provides the deep void blacks (Obsidian) grounded with sharp, high-contrast neon accents (Acid Green / Electric Cyan) to denote security states and premium tech interactions, fulfilling the 'crypto-native meets BBM nostalgia' requirement.

rules: Use 'secure_accent' (Acid Green) exclusively for encryption locks, session verification, and verified identities.
Use 'primary_accent' (Electric Cyan) for general CTAs, unread badges, and active tab indicators.
Avoid pure #000000; use #030303 as the deep void base to allow subtle shadows and glows.
Always use JetBrains Mono for Xenon IDs (e.g., XEN-1A2B-3C4D), encryption fingerprints, and timers.
Headings must have tight letter spacing.
Use 'text_secondary' for timestamps and message previews to maintain hierarchy.
BBM Nostalgia layout: Use slightly squared-off avatars (rounded-xl instead of full-circle) for a tactical, premium feel.
Maintain a strict 8pt grid. Gaps should be gap-2 (8px), gap-4 (16px), or gap-6 (24px).
Containers with borders must use 1px solid strokes (e.g., border-border) rather than heavy drop shadows.

ChatBubble.meta: text-[10px] text-text_muted font-mono mt-1 flex items-center justify-end gap-1

ChatListItem.container: flex flex-row items-center gap-4 py-3 border-b border-border/50 bg-background
ChatListItem.avatar: w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-surface_elevated border border-border relative
ChatListItem.unread_badge: w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary_accent text-background text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center

SecurityPanel.container: bg-surface border-t border-border p-6 rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-8px_32px_rgba(0,229,255,0.05)]
SecurityPanel.qr_container: p-4 bg-background border border-secure_accent/20 rounded-xl items-center justify-center

IdentitySwitcher.container: flex flex-row items-center justify-between p-4 bg-surface border-b border-border

AIChips.chip: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full border border-primary_accent/40 bg-primary_accent/10 text-primary_accent text-sm font-medium flex flex-row items-center gap-1

rules: Use smooth spring animations for the slide-up Security Panel and Identity Switcher.
Lock icons should have a subtle pulse animation (opacity 0.6 to 1) when connected securely.
Self-destruct timers should visually tick down with a monospace font and a shrinking border or progress ring.
Active pressed states on lists should scale down slightly (scale: 0.98) and darken the background.

usage: Lock: Always present next to peer names to denote E2E encryption.

rules: All interactive elements (buttons, toggles, list items) MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Expo React Native app using NativeWind (Tailwind for React Native) or StyleSheet matching the provided color hexes and classes.
Implement the Chat List screen as the initial view, with the Identity Switcher locked to the top.
The Chat Screen must feature a clear header showing the peer's XID, encryption status (green lock), and avatar.
Implement a slide-up modal (Security Panel) accessible from the chat header, displaying a mock QR code and monospace session fingerprint.
Simulate E2E functionality in the UI: monospace timers for burn mode, lock icons, and a secure feel.
Ensure 'Ghost Mode' visibly changes the UI (e.g., italicizes text, dims the read receipt indicators).
Follow the theme variables strictly. Obsidian is the default. You can mock the theme switcher in Settings.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactable UI elements for testing.
